symptoms.name: Brown tips or edges
symptoms.description: Leaf tips, edges or patches turning brown and dry.

symptoms.name: Spots or patches on leaves
symptoms.description: Spots, rings, speckles or patches on the leaves.

symptoms.name: Insects, webbing or sticky leaves
symptoms.description: Visible insects, webbing, flies or sticky residue.

symptoms.name: Slow, leggy or weak growth
symptoms.description: Little new growth, small leaves or long bare stems.

symptoms.name: Soft, mushy or rotting base
symptoms.description: Base or leaves becoming soft, mushy or translucent.

symptoms.name: Thin, wrinkled or curling leaves
symptoms.description: Succulent leaves losing plumpness, wrinkling or curling inward.

symptoms.name: Leaves bending or falling over
symptoms.name_ur: Pattiyan jhuk ya gir rahi hain
symptoms.description: Upright leaves flopping, bending or spreading flat.

symptoms.name: Leaves turning red, orange or brown
symptoms.name_ur: Pattiyon ka rang laal ya bhoora
symptoms.description: Leaves changing colour from green to red, orange or brown.

symptoms.name: Flower problems
symptoms.description: No flowers, or flowers turning green or brown.

symptoms.name: No babies / runners
symptoms.description: The plant does not produce runners or baby plantlets.
